title: [3.0-beta1] No BG delta on Beta1
symptom: BG changes (delta) at the top of the screen are reporting as '0' despite BG obviously changing. This happens every time the app is brought up (not fresh start), and after about 5 minutes (probably the next BG reading) the delta will show.
fix: Disable Dexcom bridge in NS and use only patched app.
evidence_quote: your problem is doubled BGs. Disable Dexcom bridge in NS and use only patched app
